typical_topologies: 274   Lane: Consists of two complementary Lane Modules communicating via two-line, point-to-point Lane
276   Lane Interconnect: Two-line, point-to-point interconnect used for both differential high-speed signaling

id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Point-to-point asymmetric (mostly source → sink with reverse direction Data Lane 0 in LP only). Host processor ↔ one peripheral. Normatively the DSI v1.01.00 specification only addresses host-to-single-peripheral connections; multi-peripheral via VC is informative.

supported_topologies.name: Host ↔ one peripheral, Command Mode
supported_topologies.description: Bidirectional Data Lane 0 + optional unidirectional Data Lanes 1..3; supports DCS read/write + Acknowledge + TE.

supported_topologies.name: Host ↔ one peripheral, Video Mode unidirectional
supported_topologies.description: Cost-optimized; all Data Lanes host → peripheral only.

supported_topologies.name: Host ↔ one peripheral, Video Mode bidirectional
supported_topologies.description: Data Lane 0 bidirectional for Acknowledge and Error Report.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-peripheral via VC (informative)
supported_topologies.description: Multiple peripherals share Link via DI[7:6] VC[1:0]; outside DSI v1.01 normative scope.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Drives Clock Lane DDR unconditionally; sources all forward HS/LP; initiates BTA; programs T_INIT_MASTER; implements HTX_TO + LRX-H_TO.

Powers up in RX-Stop; receives forward HS/LP; after BTA transmits Acknowledge/Error Report/Read Response/TE in LP on Data Lane 0; returns bus via own BTA; bidirectional peripheral implements HRX_TO + LTX-P_TO.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer router or hub. The link is a flat point-to-point pair (Clock Lane + N Data Lanes). Aggregation across multiple cameras happens at the host SoC's multi-port CSI-2 RX subsystem, not on the D-PHY wires.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_packet: Bytes transmitted byte-0 first; within each byte, LSB-first on the wire.
ordering_guarantees.within_a_transmission: Packets may be concatenated within a single HS transmission; when EoTp enabled the last packet is EoTp; HS Exit follows.
ordering_guarantees.within_a_frame: Video Mode: VSS → VBP lines → VACT lines (HSS + HSA + HSE + HBP + RGB + HFP per line) → VFP lines → VSE (or just next VSS in Sync-Events / Burst modes).
ordering_guarantees.across_VCs: VCs interleave at packet boundary; no ordering between VCs.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable — CSI-2 is a streaming protocol; no addressable memory or register region on the CSI-2 wires themselves. Sensor registers live on the sideband I2C bus.

device_classification.host_processor: Application processor or baseband processor with embedded DSI master controller.
device_classification.peripheral_command_mode: Active-matrix display module with on-panel display controller, frame buffer, DCS interpreter, and bidirectional DSI slave interface.
device_classification.peripheral_video_mode: Active-matrix display module without on-panel frame buffer; relies on continuous host pixel stream.
device_classification.multi_peripheral_setup: Multiple driver ICs serving different areas of a common display panel, each tagged by a different VC[1:0]; informative.
